title: FAR DTI identities: which chain and contract a DTI names
description: One row per DTI whose ledger and technical reference are known from a source that publishes them. The free monthly snapshot redacts both, so this table is empty until such a source exists. Rows here are read from a registry, never inferred; inference lives in data/links-inferred.json.

technicalReference.description: AuxiliaryTechnicalReference: the contract address or asset id on that ledger

caip19.description: Constructed from the ledger's CAIP-2 and the technical reference. Null when the ledger has no CAIP-2.

basis.description: How the row was obtained. Only registry-read rows belong here.

source.description: Which DTIF channel or file the fields were read from, and when.
